```renyi
module names.initials
  purpose: Provide helpers for formatting names.

public function initials(full_name: Text) returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-case initials from a full name.
  example: initials("ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
  example: initials("  ada   marie lovelace  ") is "AML"
  example: initials("   ") is ""

  let parts be full_name.trim().split(" ")
  let letters be
    for each part in parts
    where part.is_empty() is false
    collect part.take(1).to_upper()

  return letters.join("")
end
```

```renyi
module library.names
  purpose: Work with human names.

public function initials(full_name: Text) returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-case initials of a full name.
  example: initials("ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
  example: initials("  ada   marie  lovelace  ") is "AML"
  example: initials("   ") is ""

  let parts be full_name.trim().split(" ")
  let letters be
    for each part in parts
    where not part.is_empty()
    collect part.take(1).to_upper()
  return letters.join("")
end
```

```renyi
  purpose: Return the upper-cased initials of a full name.

    for each word in full_name.trim().split(" ")
    where word.is_empty is false
    collect word.take(1).to_upper()

  return letters.join("")
end
```

```renyi
module names.initials
  purpose: Build initials from full names.

public function initials(full_name: Text) returns Text
  purpose: Return the upper-cased initials of a full name with blanks ignored.
  example: initials(full_name: "ada marie lovelace") is "AML"
  example: initials(full_name: "  grace   brewster  hopper ") is "GBH"
  example: initials(full_name: "   ") is ""

  let parts be full_name.trim().split(" ")
  let letters be
    for each part in parts
    where not part.is_empty
    collect part.take(1).to_upper()
  return letters.join("")
end
```
